description: Identify GT51 catalytic motifs, catalytic glutamate, and N-terminal TM anchor in Q88CS3
code:
import re, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seq="MLSTLIRRLSRALLWFVAGSIVLVLVFRWVPPPGTALMVERKVQSWVNGEPIDLQRDWEPWENISDELKVAVIAGEDQKFASHWGFDLPAIQAALAHNERGGNIRGASTLTQQVAKNLFLWSGRSWFRKGLEAWFTALIELFWSKERILEVYLNSAEWGKGVFGAQAAARYHFGVDASRLSRQQAAQLAAVLPSPIKWSASRPSAYVASRAGWIRRQMSQLGGPSYLMQLDSSRKL"
n=len(seq); print("Length:",n)

# --- 1. Catalytic motif 1 of GT51: E-D-x-x-F-x-x-H-x-G  (the E is the catalytic base)
m1=re.search(r"E D . . F . . H . G".replace(" ",""), seq)
print("\nGT51 catalytic motif 1 (EDxxFxxHxG):", m1.group() if m1 else "not found",
      "at", (m1.start()+1) if m1 else None)
if m1:
    print("  -> Catalytic glutamate E at position", m1.start()+1)

# --- 2. Motif 3 conserved: contains QQ...AKNL (the 'RxxQ...' region) - GT51 motif with conserved Gln
m3=re.search(r"Q Q . A K N L".replace(" ",""), seq)
print("Motif with QQxAKNL (GT51 motif 3 region):", m3.group() if m3 else None,
      "at", (m3.start()+1) if m3 else None)

# --- 3. conserved 'RKGL' / motif region & the invariant residues
for pat,name in [("GEDQKF","motif1/catalytic E"),("ASHWGFD","motif1 His"),
                 ("TQQVAKNL","motif3 conserved Q/RxxQ"),("YLNSAE","motif4-like"),
                 ("EWGKG","conserved EWG")]:
    i=seq.find(pat)
    print(f"  {name:28s} '{pat}' -> pos {i+1 if i>=0 else 'NA'}")

# --- 4. Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy for N-terminal membrane anchor
kd={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,
    'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,
    'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=19; half=w//2
hyd=[np.mean([kd[seq[j]] for j in range(i-half,i+half+1)]) for i in range(half,n-half)]
xs=list(range(half+1,n-half+1))
peak_i=int(np.argmax(hyd)); peak_pos=xs[peak_i]
print("\nMax hydropathy window (KD, w=19) center at residue", peak_pos,
      "value %.2f"%hyd[peak_i], "(>1.6 => likely TM helix)")
# region of first hydrophobic stretch
tm_region=seq[9:30]
print("N-terminal hydrophobic stretch (res 10-30):", tm_region)

plt.figure(figsize=(9,3))
plt.plot(xs,hyd)
plt.axhline(1.6,color='r',ls='--',label='TM threshold 1.6')
plt.axvline(m1.start()+1,color='g',ls=':',label='catalytic Glu %d'%(m1.start()+1))
plt.xlabel("Residue"); plt.ylabel("KD hydropathy"); plt.title("Q88CS3 (P. putida MtgA) hydropathy")
plt.legend(); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("mtgA_hydropathy.png",dpi=110)
print("saved plot")

# composition of catalytic region context
print("\nContext around catalytic Glu:", seq[max(0,m1.start()-5):m1.start()+15])
